gshin bsngo ni/bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang bya

tei:div.tei:p: )gshin bsngo ni/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dmigs yul gyi thog drangs sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ dmigs yul 'di zhes bgyi bas skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa las byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims las byung ba dang*/ bsgom bzlas las byung ba la sogs bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs su gyur pa ci dang ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du rtsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rangs ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa dang*/ da lta 'dir yang nye du shul du mchis pa rnams kyis bla ma la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba/ yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas byas pa/ mgron bzhi la gtor ma btang ba/ sgrib sbyang gi cho ga bgyis pa la sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthus/ dmigs yul gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyams chag nag po'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /de ltar ma gyur gyi bar du yang tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du mtho ris lha dang mi yi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /rigs mchog tu gyur pa la sogs mtho ris kyi yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan par gyur cig /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang mjal zhing rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod cing rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig /le lo dang g.yeng ba thams cad rab tu spang ste sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed par gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /sa lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad med par mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par gyur cig

/mthar tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ sa bcu lam lnga pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas kyang lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las zad mi shes pa'i chos kyi mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing bstan pa dang 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don phun sum tshogs par 'byung bar gyur cig /ces stag sham 'od chog las phyungs pa'o/// /
